root_cause_analysis.narrative: Every admitted activation cell in the latest committed sweep predicts hit_rate >= 0.90 (near-saturation) and comes from a single-threadblock dynamic_trace.pb. Under the slice-aware effective-capacity model, the 5 cells' working sets all fit within the sm_86 1-MiB per-slice capacity. Under the sector-edge accounting contract-lock, every 32B access maps to one sector. Under the write-policy classifier, the committed legacy traces do not carry the memory_op_access_kind wire field so every access routes to UNSPECIFIED (no-op on the predictor's no-write-allocate filter). Under the coarse CTA/SM interleaving model, the round-robin merge reduces to the legacy sequential walk on every cell (total_threadblocks==1 per cell). The four model-refinement surfaces are correctly wired and verified by synthetic multi-TB / multi-policy witnesses, but none shifts the prediction on the committed activation corpus because the corpus is structurally homogeneous: 5 element-wise normalization/silu/softmax launches, each single-TB, each saturating L2 hit rate. The calibration-head variance-improvement precondition cannot be met by additional model refinements on this corpus; the path forward requires either expanding the corpus (e.g., microbench rehabilitation via larger shapes) or revising the precondition itself.

trajectory_rounds.comment: Post-stale-bundle-regeneration baseline. Pre-NCU-relabeling corpus (still using pre-launch-skip-fix labels); spread is widest here because the labels themselves are saturated near 1.0.
Post-diagnostic-aggregation close. First close on the refreshed activation label corpus; per-cell stddev settles into the ~0.017 band where it stays across every subsequent model-refinement close.
Post-slice-geometry-aware-effective-capacity model refinement close. No measurable shift on the activation cells (their working sets fit within the 1-MiB per-slice capacity).
Post-sector-edge-accounting-contract-lock close. Test-side regression lock only; no model surface change.

Post-write-policy-classification close. New memory_op_access_kind wire field + producer classifier + predictor no-write-allocate filter; legacy committed traces don't carry the new wire field, so the consumer-side fallback routes every observation to UNSPECIFIED.

Post-coarse-CTA/SM-interleaving close. The interleave model is wired into every cell but produces no measurable prediction shift because the 5 admitted activation cells each have a single threadblock in their committed trace (round-robin merge over 1 TB is a no-op).

Post-microbench-rehabilitation-XL-shapes close. First headline regen on the expanded 13-cell cohort that includes 4 admitted microbench cells (l2_persisting, l2_thrash, register_spill, warm_cold) alongside the 5 activation cells; geomean rises to 0.56 because the microbench cells' relative errors are larger than the near-saturation activation cells, widening the per-cell prediction spread.

Post-dram-stream-kernel-rehabilitation close. The kernel rewrite replaced the historical strided sweep with a per-warp isolated layered reuse phase, admitting the HRD bundle (bundle_underconfigured=False) at trace_l2_accuracy_xl. Live NCU sweep variance regressed several previously-admitted microbench label-side measurements (l2_persisting, warm_cold, l2_prefetch_hint, working_set stddev_l2_sector > 0.03 threshold across all warmup/cache configs); only 2 of 8 microbench cells cleared the repeatability gate this round (l2_thrash, register_spill). Comparison bundle still admits with 7 included cells per arch and geomean 0.36.

Microbench label-side recovery attempt under controlled host conditions: GPU baseline 47-52C idle, no concurrent CPU load, sweep at 09:48 UTC. Bounded 3-cell probe at --repeats 5 (dram_stream, l2_persisting, warm_cold) admitted 0 of 3; the bounded-probe route escalated to a full 13-cell sweep at --repeats 10. Result: only 1 microbench (l2_thrash_pointer_chase) cleared the stddev gate at any config; register_spill (prior-round admitted at stddev 0.010) now fails at minimum 0.053. Comparison admits 6 cells per sm_86 (1 microbench + 5 activation), geomean 0.388 CI [0.155, 0.750]; per-arch headline below the five-microbench floor; the microbench rehabilitation lever stays open. Host-thermal hypothesis NOT confirmed: the controlled idle host did not recover the prior admit rate. dram_stream additionally produces NCU CSV parse failures (lts__t_sector_hit_rate values >100% at multiple warmup configs); the per-warp isolated layered kernel may be hitting an NCU replay artifact that is independent of host thermal state. Documented for a follow-up round.

Drift-recovery round. Bounded 4-cell probe at --repeats 5 admitted 2 of 4 candidates (register_spill at min stddev 0.003; working_set at min 0.009). Full 13-cell sweep at --repeats 5 admitted 2 microbench in the headline (l2_thrash, register_spill); working_set's probe admission did not reproduce in the full sweep. New diagnostic infrastructure landed: a label-stability emitter + scanner reading committed verdict tables, plus a typed NCU lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct >100% diagnostic fixture documenting why dram_stream stays label-blocked. Comparison admits 7 cells per sm_86 (2 microbench + 5 activation), geomean 0.744 CI [0.470, 1.267]; below the five-microbench floor but advanced from the prior round's 1 of 8 to 2 of 8.
